items.name: pjm_dataminer
items.description: PJM data miner scripts to make exporting data easier.  PJM is a regional transmission organization (RTO) that coordinates the movement of wholesale electricity in all or parts of 13 states and the District of Columbia.  Utilities to connect to available public apis and output in various formats for the convenient population of a data warehouse.
